Thanking her once more for the other day, I ask the question that came to mind.
It seems she had been training all by herself, but—
My, that sounds lovely.

Even though you're already a professional Trainer?
That's amazing! You're such a hard worker!
I'm going to make my dream come true right here...!
Fufu. Flowers dance upon the wind, so to keep my view clear, I must become the wind myself, must I not?
Ah... Actually, I still have so much to learn... so, um, I was worried I might just get in everyone's way.

Mmh! In that case, let us have a rematch!
This time, I shall claim a decisive, flawless victory!

Seeing her acknowledge her inexperience yet strive forward with continuous effort
was dazzling, and it inspired me to shake off my own discouragement.

Even without a track record, there are still things I can learn. It won't go to waste.
I will work hard so that when I finally find the Umamusume I'm meant to train, I can support her with everything I have.

Oh? I believe I crossed the finish line first.
Hmm, without anyone to judge, it is rather difficult to tell.

Huh...?
...No wonder, compared to usual...

! Oho, a challenge, you say?! Very well!
Whenever and wherever challenged, I shall answer the call!

I see. Even if they recognized my talent, I'm... still just a kid.
Then I have to work even harder... much harder than I am right now.

(—I can't catch up. It hurts. I can't breathe properly.
The sound of horseshoes is pulling further and further away.)

(Looking up, cherry blossoms were blooming in the high sky.
But... my flower hasn't bloomed yet.)

With the older girls...?
Y-Yes! Thank you!

(Even after running like that... the older girls have already caught their breath...
They're completely different from me...)

Geez............!
From here, I'll push myself even harder—

(That Trainer said... they felt encouraged seeing me.
Ehehe... I'm so happy. I have to work even harder!)
Mmh! You over there!

Daddy and Mommy will always be cheering you on.
If you ever need anything, tell us right away, okay?!

Today's wind will surely carry the scent of blossoms.
Fufu, let us enjoy it.

Um, together... with you?
Y-Yes! Thank you so much!

I'm okay! It's just not my time yet.
I'm going to work super hard from now on so I can catch up!

Even so, skipping grades to enroll... That means they truly recognized your talent, Flower-chan.
Mommy's heart is still fluttering with excitement!
Why... ngh...!

What a pleasant morning.
If you'd like, would you care to run together with everyone?

What do you say, care to break a sweat with me? Let's do it!
As fellow Umamusume studying together here at Tracen Academy!!
Y-Yes?!
—Huh?

Little by little each day, I find myself able to do things I couldn't do before!
Ehehe.

Ah, Sky-san! Fufu, yes!
Something really, really wonderful happened!
? Mine?
...Ngh, Flower!

Ah, you're the Trainer from the other day, right?
I'm Nishino Flower. Is your injury all better now?

Fufu, not quite so easily.
Now, watch out for the gusting breeze...!

(The two of them reaching the finish line looked so small...
I couldn't even see them clearly.)

Hahaha! I can still keep going...!
Here I gooooooo!

Ah. Are you here to read books too?
Whoa, there are so many difficult-looking books...
...Ngh, haah, haah... haah...!

(—Time and time again after that, I realized how different I was from everyone around me.
My physique... my strength, my experience—I was lacking in absolutely everything.)

Nishino Flower offered a warm smile as she spoke.
Bowing deeply to me, she returned to her training.

(Thank you, Daddy, Mommy. And thank you,
Tracen Academy, for believing in me...)
Bakushin, bakushin, bakushiiin!!

Hmm, as expected of me! It came down to a close race
at the end, but I emerged completely victorious! Still,
both of you had splendid runs as well!

Today, I headed to the training course again in search
of an Umamusume to scout. Then, in the corner of the track—
While spending time in the library trying to learn as much as I could—

Oh, hey there, Flower.
What's up~? You sure seem in high spirits~.

Phew... No, that's not quite right.
When Bakushin O-san steps in, it's more like...

Phew! Today was another wonderful run of pure bakushin!
This is the running of an honor student! And yet, something feels lacking...
